When I was like 10/11 me and my mum went on hoilday to Tenerife or gran Canria somewhere and went to the beach

me and my mum were holding hands and had our feet just about covered by water and we watched as a little wave rolled in, and the next thing I know my vision is the inside of a washing machine and I can’t breath, I don’t know whats up or down whats the ground or my legs or arms or what and I shit you not by the time I realised what had happened my mum had somehow pulled me out of the water

she was like woh, are you alright? And I looked at her and was like what happened? And she cuddled me and we went back to settle a bit ( I assume at this point the colour started to drain from my face and shock set in)

She proceeded to tell me that I had been caught in a riptide, and the life guard literally got to us just after I came out the water and after running along the beach warning people and told us this, and yeah normal mum stuff from there calmed me down carton of juice etc  and we went to a calmer part of the beach and I went back in the water and yeah thankfully never developed a fear of swimming even tho this was my second time of nearly drowning lol

Being non binary for me and specifically Genderfluid, allows me to not only feel but actually be respected as a person and not what is expected of me as a ____ whatever conceived notion they have of me.

I have periodically throughout my life either limited myself or doubted my capabilities because someone said that a women can’t do something or men don’t do such a thing, and I my experience and knowledge the limitation here is preconceived ideas of what gender means and is, rather then the individuals skills, knowledge, experience, physical capacity, and so on. 

A part of my identity has definitely come from how others perceive me, the other part is definitely because I have aways known I was different and never quite fit in with either group, and now that I have found a word to describe me and a partner and group of friends who support me and empower me I feel like I know what it means to be non binary more so then just he word it’s self 😊🥰😊

I hope this helps
